paragraphs.text: Trygve is a human axe thrower and sportsman from Kaldheim , and friend of Niko Aris .

Trygve is a burly hunter from Kaldheim , known more for his impressive skill in throwing axes than for his abilities with a bow. Despite his prowess in the sport of axe-throwing, he is not a particularly successful hunter. Trygve is a well-liked figure in his community, often found among the local hunters, participating in games of skill and strength. His signature move is striking targets dead center, earning cheers from his peers.

Upon Tyvar Kell bringing Kaito Shizuki to find Niko Aris , Trygve showcased his talents during an axe-throwing game in a feast hall. With a nonchalant toss, he managed to hit the smallest target dead center, impressing the gathered hunters. However, his moment of glory was quickly overshadowed when Niko split his axe handle with their throw, demonstrating even greater precision. Despite this, Trygve remained a jovial and competitive presence in the hall, enjoying the camaraderie and sportsmanship of the events.
